full_page.content:
1935, December
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 80 Dec. 22 Tillie Mouske - 30 - Lutherine - nerveous - has had much sorrow - partly crippled - seemingly would like to be Cath.
Marg. Machine - 18 - in (Harper Hosp'l) blind now four months. One of seven children, has a brother 19 lame and a sister 14 also lame .... prayers asked - seem to be good simple, faithful people.
Vernan Van Slambrouch of Monroe, Mich. - 11 - infantile paralysis since August 1934
Emil De Backe - 43 - away from home two years - Beer garden .. Mary Thimm & Brother - asks prayers for Employment.
Catherine Quinlan - 32 - mentally unbalanced through accident her father met with a year ago. Shocked. ....
Frank Peters - 35 - has wife and 4 small children - vanished last July and has not been heard from since. Wife not Cath. Children not baptized.
Page 81 Dec. 30 Mary O'R. Cahill - 30 - threatened for a year and half. .. operated on June 1934 for stomach cancer. ...
1936 In NOMINE DOMINI Incipit A. D. 1936, January
Jan. V. Mother M. Laurence Brady - Good Shepherd Provincials diabetis .. threatening ...
Leo Cierpia1 - 14 - paralyzed in right arm since 5 .. ... . Marion Rockwell - 74 - inemic
Germaine DeBacker - 14 - Epil ... 3 since two yrs. old ...
Young girl wanted to do light house-work - help with 3 little ones. Solone Fryaynski - 54 - choking according to a curse by her mother.
Page 82 Jan. John McHugh - 87 - hardening of arteries - childish ..... anointed New Yrs. Day.
Nestor Law ... & Vincent
